# The Notepad++ application bundle: upstream's objects, the runtime, Scintilla and Lexilla.

# --- COM interface identifiers (Wine's uuid library, generated by widl) ------------------------
file(GLOB nppUuidSources "${NPPMAC_WINE_UUID_DIR}/*_i.c")
add_library(nppUuid STATIC ${nppUuidSources})
target_link_libraries(nppUuid PRIVATE nppRuntimeHeaders)
target_compile_options(nppUuid PRIVATE -w)

# --- Stubs for Win32 functions not implemented yet -----------------------------------------------
set(nppSystemLibraries "-framework Cocoa" "-framework QuartzCore" "-framework IOSurface" "-framework CoreText" "-framework Security" "-framework UniformTypeIdentifiers"
	"-framework PDFKit" "-framework Metal")
# The probe also gets what the runtime links itself (iconv).
string(REPLACE ";" "|" nppSystemLibrariesArgument "-lc++;-liconv;${nppSystemLibraries}") # a list cannot pass through -D
string(REPLACE " " "|" nppSystemLibrariesArgument "${nppSystemLibrariesArgument}")
set(stubInputs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/stub-inputs.txt")
set(stubProviders "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/stub-providers.txt")
set(stubSource "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/RuntimeStubs.c")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${stubInputs}" CONTENT
	"$<JOIN:$<TARGET_OBJECTS:nppUpstream>,\n>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppRuntime>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppScintilla>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppLexilla>\n")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${stubProviders}" CONTENT
	"$<JOIN:$<TARGET_OBJECTS:nppUpstream>,\n>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppRuntime>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppScintilla>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppLexilla>\n$<TARGET_FILE:nppUuid>\n")

add_custom_command(
	OUTPUT "${stubSource}"
	COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -DNM=${CMAKE_NM} -DCC=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} "-DLINK_LIBRARIES=${nppSystemLibrariesArgument}"
		-DINPUTS_FILE=${stubInputs} -DPROVIDERS_FILE=${stubProviders} -DOUTPUT=${stubSource}
		-P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../runtime/stubs/GenerateStubs.cmake"
	DEPENDS nppUpstream nppRuntime nppScintilla nppLexilla nppUuid
		$<TARGET_OBJECTS:nppUpstream> "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../runtime/stubs/GenerateStubs.cmake"
	COMMENT "Generating stubs for Win32 functions the runtime does not implement yet"
	VERBATIM
)
add_library(nppRuntimeStubs STATIC "${stubSource}")
target_compile_options(nppRuntimeStubs PRIVATE -w)

# --- Application -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(nppResources "")
macro(nppAddResources destination)
	foreach(resourceFile ${ARGN})
		set_source_files_properties("${resourceFile}" PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION "Resources/${destination}")
		list(APPEND nppResources "${resourceFile}")
	endforeach()
endmacro()

set(nppInstaller "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/installer")
file(GLOB nppLocalization CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppInstaller}/nativeLang/*.xml")
file(GLOB nppAutoCompletion CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppInstaller}/APIs/*.xml")
file(GLOB nppFunctionList CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppInstaller}/functionList/*.xml")
file(GLOB nppThemes CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppInstaller}/themes/*.xml")
file(GLOB nppUserDefineLangs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/bin/userDefineLangs/markdown._preinstalled*.udl.xml")
file(GLOB scintillaResources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${NPP_ROOT}/scintilla/cocoa/res/*.png")

# Laid out as upstream's packageAll.bat lays out the Windows zip; Contents/Resources is the
# program directory Notepad++ sees (GetModuleFileNameW points there).
nppAddResources("" "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/langs.model.xml" "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/stylers.model.xml"
	"${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/tabContextMenu_example.xml" "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/toolbarButtonsConf_example.xml"
	"${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/bin/readme.txt" "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/bin/change.log"
	"${nppInstaller}/xml4Config/disableNppAutoUpdate.xml" ${scintillaResources})
# The translations go through the engine for its text rules (where they name Windows the OS).
set(nppGeneratedLocalization "")
foreach(languageFile IN LISTS nppLocalization)
	get_filename_component(languageName "${languageFile}" NAME)
	list(APPEND nppGeneratedLocalization "${NPPMAC_GENERATED_DIR}/nativeLang/${languageName}")
endforeach()
add_custom_command(
	OUTPUT ${nppGeneratedLocalization}
	COMMAND npp-migrate "${nppInstaller}/nativeLang" "${NPPMAC_GENERATED_DIR}/nativeLang"
		--text-rules "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../text-rules.txt" --text-base installer/nativeLang
	# The engine writes only what changed; the outputs are touched so the step is not rerun.
	COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E touch ${nppGeneratedLocalization}
	DEPENDS npp-migrate ${nppLocalization} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../text-rules.txt"
	COMMENT "Applying the text rules to the translations"
	VERBATIM
)
nppAddResources("localization" ${nppGeneratedLocalization})
nppAddResources("autoCompletion" ${nppAutoCompletion})
nppAddResources("functionList" ${nppFunctionList})
nppAddResources("themes" ${nppThemes})
nppAddResources("userDefineLangs" ${nppUserDefineLangs})

# The app icon, made from NPPMAC_APP_ICON.
set(appIcon "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/AppIcon.icns")
add_custom_command(
	OUTPUT "${appIcon}"
	COMMAND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/make-icns.sh" "${NPPMAC_APP_ICON}" "${appIcon}"
	DEPENDS "${NPPMAC_APP_ICON}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/make-icns.sh"
	COMMENT "Making the app icon"
	VERBATIM
)
set_source_files_properties("${appIcon}" PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION Resources)

# The extensions of the languages Notepad++ knows (langs.model.xml and the preinstalled user-defined
# languages), for which Info.plist.in offers the app: Finder lists it in Open With for them and can
# make it their default (Get Info, Change All), also where macOS has no type for the extension (.st).
set(nppDocumentExtensions "")
set(nppLanguageFiles "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/langs.model.xml" ${nppUserDefineLangs})
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${nppLanguageFiles})
foreach(languageFile IN LISTS nppLanguageFiles)
	file(READ "${languageFile}" languages)
	string(REPLACE ";" "," languages "${languages}") # a comment character (commentLine=";") would split the list
	string(REGEX MATCHALL "<(Language|UserLang) [^>]* ext=\"[^\"]*\"" languageTags "${languages}")
	foreach(languageTag IN LISTS languageTags)
		string(REGEX REPLACE ".* ext=\"([^\"]*)\"" "\\1" languageExtensions "${languageTag}")
		string(TOLOWER "${languageExtensions}" languageExtensions)
		string(REGEX REPLACE "[ \t]+" ";" languageExtensions "${languageExtensions}")
		list(APPEND nppDocumentExtensions ${languageExtensions})
	endforeach()
endforeach()
list(REMOVE_ITEM nppDocumentExtensions "")
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES nppDocumentExtensions)
list(SORT nppDocumentExtensions)
list(LENGTH nppDocumentExtensions nppDocumentExtensionCount)
if(nppDocumentExtensionCount LESS 100)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "Only ${nppDocumentExtensionCount} extensions found in Notepad++'s languages: has langs.model.xml changed form?")
endif()
list(TRANSFORM nppDocumentExtensions PREPEND "\t\t\t\t<string>")
list(TRANSFORM nppDocumentExtensions APPEND "</string>")
list(JOIN nppDocumentExtensions "\n" nppDocumentExtensions)

# W37: what Finder calls the files (their Kind). It takes the name from the app that opens a type, else from the
# type's own description; macOS gives plain text no name of its own and knows many of these extensions not at all
# ("Document"). So each language of langs.model.xml is declared as a type of the app's own, named as upstream's
# status bar names it (ScintillaEditView.cpp's long names), as text, and claimed under that name. The declarations
# are imported ones: wherever macOS has a type of its own for an extension (.c, .py, .as), macOS's comes first and
# keeps its name. Plain text is named as TextEdit names it, in Info.plist.in.
set(nppEditView "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/ScintillaComponent/ScintillaEditView.cpp")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${nppEditView}")
file(READ "${nppEditView}" nppEditViewSource)
string(REPLACE ";" "," nppEditViewSource "${nppEditViewSource}")
# {L"batch", L"Batch", L"Batch file", L_BATCH, "batch"}: the language, its short name and its long name.
string(REGEX MATCHALL "{L\"[^\"]*\", *L\"[^\"]*\", *L\"[^\"]*\"" nppLanguageNames "${nppEditViewSource}")
foreach(languageName IN LISTS nppLanguageNames)
	string(REGEX REPLACE "{L\"([^\"]*)\", *L\"[^\"]*\", *L\"([^\"]*)\"" "\\1" language "${languageName}")
	string(REGEX REPLACE "{L\"([^\"]*)\", *L\"[^\"]*\", *L\"([^\"]*)\"" "\\2" longName "${languageName}")
	set("nppLongName_${language}" "${longName}")
endforeach()
file(READ "${NPP_ROOT}/PowerEditor/src/langs.model.xml" languages)
string(REPLACE ";" "," languages "${languages}")
string(REGEX MATCHALL "<Language name=\"[^\"]*\" ext=\"[^\"]*\"" languageTags "${languages}")
set(nppImportedTypes "")
set(nppLanguageDocumentTypes "")
set(nppDeclaredExtensions "")
set(nppDeclaredLanguageCount 0)
foreach(languageTag IN LISTS languageTags)
	string(REGEX REPLACE "<Language name=\"([^\"]*)\" ext=\"([^\"]*)\"" "\\1" language "${languageTag}")
	string(REGEX REPLACE "<Language name=\"([^\"]*)\" ext=\"([^\"]*)\"" "\\2" languageExtensions "${languageTag}")
	string(TOLOWER "${languageExtensions}" languageExtensions)
	string(REGEX REPLACE "[ \t]+" ";" languageExtensions "${languageExtensions}")
	list(REMOVE_ITEM languageExtensions "")
	# Plain text is macOS's own type; an extension is declared once, for the first language that has it.
	if(nppDeclaredExtensions)
		list(REMOVE_ITEM languageExtensions ${nppDeclaredExtensions})
	endif()
	if(language STREQUAL "normal" OR NOT languageExtensions OR NOT DEFINED "nppLongName_${language}")
		continue()
	endif()
	list(APPEND nppDeclaredExtensions ${languageExtensions})
	math(EXPR nppDeclaredLanguageCount "${nppDeclaredLanguageCount} + 1")
	string(REGEX REPLACE "[^A-Za-z0-9.-]" "-" typeName "${language}")
	set(typeIdentifier "${NPPMAC_BUNDLE_ID}.language.${typeName}")
	set(longName "${nppLongName_${language}}")
	string(REPLACE "&" "&amp;" longName "${longName}")
	string(REPLACE "<" "&lt;" longName "${longName}")
	string(REPLACE ">" "&gt;" longName "${longName}")
	list(TRANSFORM languageExtensions PREPEND "\t\t\t\t\t<string>")
	list(TRANSFORM languageExtensions APPEND "</string>")
	list(JOIN languageExtensions "\n" languageExtensions)
	string(APPEND nppImportedTypes
		"\t\t<dict>\n"
		"\t\t\t<key>UTTypeIdentifier</key>\n\t\t\t<string>${typeIdentifier}</string>\n"
		"\t\t\t<key>UTTypeDescription</key>\n\t\t\t<string>${longName}</string>\n"
		"\t\t\t<key>UTTypeConformsTo</key>\n\t\t\t<array>\n\t\t\t\t<string>public.plain-text</string>\n\t\t\t</array>\n"
		"\t\t\t<key>UTTypeTagSpecification</key>\n\t\t\t<dict>\n"
		"\t\t\t\t<key>public.filename-extension</key>\n\t\t\t\t<array>\n${languageExtensions}\n\t\t\t\t</array>\n"
		"\t\t\t</dict>\n"
		"\t\t</dict>\n")
	string(APPEND nppLanguageDocumentTypes
		"\t\t<dict>\n"
		"\t\t\t<key>CFBundleTypeName</key>\n\t\t\t<string>${longName}</string>\n"
		"\t\t\t<key>CFBundleTypeRole</key>\n\t\t\t<string>Editor</string>\n"
		"\t\t\t<key>LSHandlerRank</key>\n\t\t\t<string>Alternate</string>\n"
		"\t\t\t<key>LSItemContentTypes</key>\n\t\t\t<array>\n\t\t\t\t<string>${typeIdentifier}</string>\n\t\t\t</array>\n"
		"\t\t</dict>\n")
endforeach()
if(nppDeclaredLanguageCount LESS 50)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "Only ${nppDeclaredLanguageCount} languages named from ScintillaEditView.cpp and langs.model.xml: has either changed form?")
endif()

add_executable(NotepadPlusPlus MACOSX_BUNDLE main.cpp $<TARGET_OBJECTS:nppUpstream> ${nppResources} "${appIcon}")
set_target_properties(NotepadPlusPlus PROPERTIES
	OUTPUT_NAME "${NPPMAC_APP_NAME}"
	MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Info.plist.in"
	MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "${NPPMAC_APP_NAME}"
	MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "${NPPMAC_BUNDLE_ID}"
	MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE "AppIcon.icns"
)
target_compile_definitions(NotepadPlusPlus PRIVATE "NPPMAC_APP_NAME=\"${NPPMAC_APP_NAME}\"")
target_include_directories(NotepadPlusPlus PRIVATE "${NPPMAC_GENERATED_SRC}")
# The whole runtime goes in, not only what Notepad++ itself calls: plugins bind to the Win32 functions
# they use in the app (see macos/plugins).
target_link_libraries(NotepadPlusPlus PRIVATE
	"$<LINK_LIBRARY:WHOLE_ARCHIVE,nppRuntime>" nppRuntimeHeaders nppRuntimeStubs nppUuid nppScintilla nppLexilla
	${nppSystemLibraries}
)

# --- Resources ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Upstream's .rc files (rcFiles in PowerEditor/src/CMakeLists.txt), compiled with llvm-rc in
# upstream's directory and with upstream's include list and headers, as on Windows; the .rc text
# itself is the engine's copy, with its text rules applied (copied apart from the migrated headers).
# The .res files go into Contents/Resources/res, where the runtime's resource loader reads them.
find_program(NPPMAC_LLVM_RC llvm-rc HINTS /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin /usr/local/opt/llvm/bin REQUIRED)
string(REGEX MATCH "SET\\(rcFiles([^)]*)\\)" nppRcMatch "${nppUpstreamCMake}")
string(REGEX REPLACE "[ \t\r\n]+" ";" nppRcFiles "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
list(FILTER nppRcFiles INCLUDE REGEX "\\.rc$")
string(REGEX MATCH "SET\\(projIncludDir([^)]*)\\)" nppRcIncludeMatch "${nppUpstreamCMake}")
string(REGEX REPLACE "[ \t\r\n]+" ";" nppRcIncludes "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
set(nppRcFlags "")
foreach(includeDir IN LISTS nppRcIncludes)
	if(NOT includeDir STREQUAL "")
		list(APPEND nppRcFlags -I "${includeDir}")
	endif()
endforeach()
list(APPEND nppRcFlags -I "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../runtime/include")
foreach(wineDir IN LISTS NPPMAC_WINE_INCLUDE_DIRS)
	list(APPEND nppRcFlags -I "${wineDir}")
endforeach()

set(nppResFiles "")
foreach(rcFile IN LISTS nppRcFiles)
	string(REGEX REPLACE "^\\./" "" rcRelative "${rcFile}")
	get_filename_component(rcName "${rcRelative}" NAME_WE)
	set(resFile "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/res/${rcName}.res")
	get_filename_component(rcDirectory "${NPP_UPSTREAM_SRC}/${rcRelative}" DIRECTORY)
	file(GLOB rcDependencies "${rcDirectory}/*.h" "${rcDirectory}/*.rc")
	set(rcText "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/rc/${rcRelative}")
	# Relative: llvm-rc reads an argument starting with '/' as an option.
	file(RELATIVE_PATH rcTextRelative "${NPP_UPSTREAM_SRC}" "${rcText}")
	add_custom_command(
		OUTPUT "${resFile}"
		COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/res"
		COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${NPPMAC_GENERATED_SRC}/${rcRelative}" "${rcText}"
		COMMAND "${NPPMAC_LLVM_RC}" -I "${rcDirectory}" ${nppRcFlags} -c 65001 -D_WIN64 -DUNICODE -D_UNICODE -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0601 -DNTDDI_VERSION=0x06010000
			-fo "${resFile}" "${rcTextRelative}"
		WORKING_DIRECTORY "${NPP_UPSTREAM_SRC}"
		DEPENDS "${NPPMAC_GENERATED_DIR}/migration-report.tsv" "${NPP_UPSTREAM_SRC}/${rcRelative}" ${rcDependencies}
		COMMENT "Compiling resources ${rcRelative}"
		VERBATIM
	)
	set_source_files_properties("${resFile}" PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION "Resources/res")
	list(APPEND nppResFiles "${resFile}")
endforeach()
target_sources(NotepadPlusPlus PRIVATE ${nppResFiles})

# Plugins Admin's updater, where Notepad++ looks for it: updater/gup.exe in the program folder.
add_dependencies(NotepadPlusPlus nppGup)
# Resources/notepad++.exe, the program's file as upstream sees it (GetModuleFileName), is the executable:
# upstream reads its version from that file (Plugins Admin's compatibility checks), so it must exist.
add_custom_command(TARGET NotepadPlusPlus POST_BUILD
	COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E create_symlink "../MacOS/$<TARGET_FILE_NAME:NotepadPlusPlus>" "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_CONTENT_DIR:NotepadPlusPlus>/Resources/notepad++.exe"
	COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_CONTENT_DIR:NotepadPlusPlus>/Resources/updater"
	COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "$<TARGET_FILE:nppGup>" "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_CONTENT_DIR:NotepadPlusPlus>/Resources/updater/gup.exe"
	VERBATIM
)

# --- Tests -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The names Finder gives the files the app opens (W37): its Info.plist, and what macOS makes of it once
# the app is registered.
add_test(NAME nppFileKinds COMMAND xcrun swift "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../ci/file-kinds.swift"
	"$<TARGET_BUNDLE_DIR:NotepadPlusPlus>")
set_tests_properties(nppFileKinds PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 120)

# The end-to-end smoke test needs a window server (a logged-in macOS session); its label lets it be
# left out with ctest -LE gui.
add_test(NAME nppSmokeTest COMMAND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../ci/smoke-test.sh" "$<TARGET_FILE:NotepadPlusPlus>" "$<TARGET_FILE:HelloMac>"
	"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:HelloMac>/..")
set_tests_properties(nppSmokeTest PROPERTIES LABELS gui TIMEOUT 600)
# The other slice of a universal app, where the Mac can run it.
if("x86_64" IN_LIST CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES AND CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "arm64")
	add_test(NAME nppSmokeTestX86_64 COMMAND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../ci/smoke-test.sh" "$<TARGET_FILE:NotepadPlusPlus>" "$<TARGET_FILE:HelloMac>"
		"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:HelloMac>/..")
	set_tests_properties(nppSmokeTestX86_64 PROPERTIES LABELS gui TIMEOUT 600 ENVIRONMENT NPPMAC_TEST_ARCH=x86_64 SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
endif()
